preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 5000 for n in [int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the string n is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip([int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)], [input().strip() for _ in range(t)]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the string s matches the given length n.

preconditions.expression: all(s.islower() and s.isalpha() for s in [input().strip() for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the string s consists of lowercase latin letters only.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(s) for s in [input().strip() for _ in range(t)]) <= 5000
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all strings s over all test cases does not exceed 5000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s_prime, str) and s_prime.islower() and s_prime.isalpha() for s_prime in [output[i*2].strip() for i in range(t)])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string s' is a lowercase alphabetic string.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s_prime) == n for n, s_prime in zip([int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)], [output[i*2].strip() for i in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the output string s' matches the length of the input string n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= n for n, k in zip([int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)], [int(output[i*2+1].strip()) for i in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the chosen value of k is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(s_prime == min(modified_strings) for n, s, s_prime in zip([int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)], [input().strip() for _ in range(t)], [output[i*2].strip() for i in range(t)]) for k in range(1, n+1) for modified_strings in [[s[i:i+k][::-1] + s[i+k:] for i in range(n-k+1)]])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string s' is the lexicographically smallest string achievable by the described modification.

postconditions.expression: all(k == min([k for k in range(1, n+1) for modified_strings in [[s[i:i+k][::-1] + s[i+k:] for i in range(n-k+1)]] if modified_strings[0] == min(modified_strings)]) for n, s, k in zip([int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)], [input().strip() for _ in range(t)], [int(output[i*2+1].strip()) for i in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the chosen value of k is the smallest value that results in the lexicographically smallest string s'.
